mapper.select: select de.device_code deviceCode, (case when length(IFNULL(ten.device_name, '')) = 0 then de.device_name else ten.device_name end ) deviceName, de.longitude, de.latitude, de.site_code siteCode, ST_DISTANCE(POINT(#{longitude},#{latitude}),POINT(de.longitude,de.latitude))*111195 AS distance from vm_order_devices ord left join vm_device_info_t de on ord.device_code = de.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_channel_rel_t ten on ten.device_code = ord.device_code and ten.tenant_id = ord.tenant_id and ten.delete_flag='0' and ten.industry_code = ord.industry_code where ord.delete_flag = '0' and de.delete_flag = '0' and ord.ord_status in (0, 1, 2) and de.device_status != 2 and ord.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ord.industry_code = #{industryCode} and ST_DISTANCE(POINT(#{longitude},#{latitude}),POINT(de.longitude,de.latitude))*111195 <= #{distance} ${dataScope} order by de.site_code, de.device_status, de.device_code

choose.when: SELECT longitude,latitude FROM vm_device_info_t WHERE delete_flag = '0' AND device_code = #{deviceCode}
SELECT longitude,latitude FROM vm_iot_device_t WHERE delete_flag = '0' AND device_code = #{deviceCode}
choose.otherwise: SELECT DISTINCT tmp.longitude,tmp.latitude FROM ( SELECT longitude,latitude FROM vm_device_info_t WHERE delete_flag = '0' AND device_code = #{deviceCode} UNION ALL SELECT longitude,latitude FROM vm_iot_device_t WHERE delete_flag = '0' AND device_code = #{deviceCode} ) tmp

mapper.select: SELECT count( a.device_code ) AS totalCnt, sum( CASE WHEN a.device_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS onlineCnt FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT t1.device_code, t2.device_status FROM vm_order_devices t1 LEFT JOIN vm_device_info_t t2 ON t1.device_code = t2.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_channel_info_t ci ON ci.device_code = t1.device_code WHERE t1.delete_flag = 0 AND t1.ord_status IN ( 0, 1, 2 ) AND t2.delete_flag = 0 AND ci.delete_flag = 0 ${dataScope} ) a
